title: Coral and the Alibi
author: O. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Underhill, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
